title: HeTGB: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Heterophilic Text-Attributed Graphs
abstract: arXiv:2503.04822v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Graph neural networks (GNNs) have demonstrated success in modeling relational data primarily under the assumption of homophily. However, many real-world graphs exhibit heterophily, where linked nodes belong to different categories or possess diverse attributes, such as webpages, Wikipedia articles, social networks, and e-commerce platforms. Additionally, nodes in many domains are associated with textual descriptions, forming heterophilic text-attributed graphs (TAGs). Despite their significance, heterophilic TAGs remain underexplored due to the lack of dedicated benchmarks that jointly capture heterophilic structures and rich textual attributes. To address this gap, we introduce the \textbf{He}terophilic \textbf{T}ext-attributed \textbf{G}raph \textbf{B}enchmark (HeTGB), a novel benchmark comprising five real-world heterophilic graph datasets from diverse domains, with nodes enriched by extensive textual descriptions. translated_title: HeTGB：异配文本属性图的综合基准测试
translated_abstract: 图神经网络（GNN）主要在同配性假设下展现了建模关系数据的成功。然而，许多真实世界的图表现出异配性，即相连的节点属于不同类别或具有多样的属性，例如网页、维基百科文章、社交网络和电子商务平台。此外，许多领域的节点都与文本描述相关联，从而形成异配文本属性图（TAG）。尽管其重要性显著，但由于缺乏能够同时捕捉异配结构和丰富文本属性的专用基准，异配TAG仍未得到充分探索。为填补这一空白，我们引入了异配文本属性图基准（HeTGB），这是一个新颖的基准，包含来自不同领域的五个真实世界异配图数据集，其节点通过丰富的文本描述得到增强。
tldr: 提出了HeTGB基准，包含五个来自不同领域、节点带有丰富文本描述的真实世界异配文本属性图数据集，填补了同时捕捉异配结构与丰富文本属性的基准空白。
